notes.title: Patch Notes Ver. 1.1.0
notes.notes:
This update brings brand-new features and multiple optimizations!

🔹 New Feature: Enhanced Vending Machine! 🤖💰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289265/b5a61e65f6750225a657122911d96081556f7eab.png[/img]

Now you can upgrade the vending machine to unlock even more powerful effects!
The auto-restocking function has been integrated, making it easier to replenish products without the hassle of manual placement!

🐞 Bug Fixes & Improvements 🛠️

✅ New Additions:
Added sorting functionality to the inventory display when listing items.
Introduced the vending machine upgrade system.

🐛 Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where scrolling with the mouse wheel behaved incorrectly.
Prevented the listing window from scrolling when no stock is available.
Fixed a bug where achievement triggers were missing for level-up rewards.
Corrected an issue where the item count in Cat Exploration settlement was miscalculated.

🔧 Adjustments:
Adjusted the text length in some descriptions to prevent overflow.
Refined the UI layout of the vending machine.

💬 Thank you for your support and feedback!
We will continue to improve Dungeon Vending Machine, so feel free to join our community and share your thoughts! 🎮

🔹 Next Update Preview: Crafting Process Optimization! 🛠️✨
We’ve received a lot of feedback from players that the crafting process feels too complicated, so we’re planning to improve it in the next update!
Our goal is to make crafting smoother and more intuitive for everyone.

notes.title: Final Demo Version 0.5.0
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Demo Version 0.5.0 is now live!

This update introduces an all-new system: Cat Expedition, making your gameplay even more fun and engaging!
As you work hard to expand your vending machine empire, it’s only natural to wish for a little extra help.
Now, your wish has come true! you can adopt adorable feline companions!

Once you bring them home, they’re not just your friends—they’re your best helpers.
Assign them to explore, and they’ll bring back rare items you can’t find in the shop, boosting your profits.
Don’t forget to level up your cats to improve their stamina, allowing them to explore further and bring you even more surprises!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289265/255d875f44fd5d7af528ce0c200f9c6e6b8bc085.png[/img]

This will also be the final demo version at this stage.
Our focus will shift to expanding content for the official release.
Of course, any bug fixes will still be applied to the demo version.

We welcome any feedback, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us!

Now, update your game and experience the exciting new Cat Expedition system!

notes.title: Demo Upgraded to Version 0.4.0!
notes.notes:
After a few busy weeks, we’ve released a new version: Demo 0.4.0!
We’ve made a lot of changes based on your feedback.

[h3]Major Adjustments to Item Durations[/h3]
Significant adjustments to the profitability and duration of each item.
A new Forging System has been introduced to support these changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289265/9745c2c0367e83b9f7cc646e9cef9002f1879d4c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Revamped Shop UI[/h3]
The original shop interface didn’t feel very intuitive, so we’ve completely revamped the shop UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289265/4d0c2baeaf342924f447d80186f604602e1dc561.jpg[/img]

Of course, we’ve also fixed numerous bugs—thank you so much for your reports!
If there are still any unresolved issues, feel free to let us know on Discord.

We hope this version makes the game even more enjoyable.
If you have any suggestions, don’t hesitate to share them with us so we can make the game even better!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Demo Launch! Become the Dungeon’s Master Merchant!
notes.notes:
🚀 Demo Release is Live! Adventurers, the Challenge Awaits! 🎮

Our game demo is officially out! Dive in to experience a slice of the excitement and see just how epic the vending machine kingdom in the dungeon really is! 🎉

In this game, you’ll be the sole supplier in the dungeon, running your own vending machines to support adventurers every step of the way. From health potions to combat gear and mysterious treasures—it’s all waiting for you to stock up!

Demo Highlights: 🛠 Multiple vending machines and products for custom setups
🌌 Unique dungeon environments and immersive adventure challenges
📈 Idle management gameplay—easily collect income and upgrade for added fun!

Download the demo now and share your thoughts or any issues you encounter. We’re excited to hear from you and hope you enjoy building your thriving dungeon business! 💰

Looking forward to your feedback!
